Verify: World title display unit tests

tests.name: Given the public world endpoint returns the-boys-room, when AdminApp renders, then the level 1 heading shows the world title
tests.title: AdminApp world title shows the world title in the level 1 heading
tests.scenario: Given the public world endpoint returns the-boys-room, when AdminApp renders, then the level 1 heading shows the world title
tests.detail: Passed: heading contains 'The Boys Room' and the admin round call carries Bearer secret.

tests.id: adminWorld.test.tsx: falls back to world id on 404
tests.name: Given the world lookup returns 404, when AdminApp renders, then the heading falls back to the world id and no error alert is shown
tests.title: AdminApp world title falls back to the world id without an alert when the world lookup fails
tests.scenario: Given the world lookup returns 404, when AdminApp renders, then the heading falls back to the world id and no error alert is shown
tests.detail: Passed: heading contains 'the-boys-room' and no role=alert is rendered.

units.title: Verify: Create round duration request unit tests

tests.name: AdminApp Create round > Given an authenticated admin who sets the duration to 12 hours, when Create round is clicked, then a POST to /api/v1/admin/rounds is sent with a Bearer header and the body {world_id, duration: "12h"}
tests.title: Create round sends a POST with a Bearer header and body {world_id: 'the-boys-room', duration: '12h'}
tests.scenario: Given an authenticated admin who sets Duration (hours) to 12, When Create round is clicked, Then a POST to /api/v1/admin/rounds carries Authorization Bearer secret and the JSON body {world_id:'the-boys-room', duration:'12h'}
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminCreateRound.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: AdminApp Create round > Given an admin whose create-round request returns 401, when Create round is clicked, then the Invalid token alert is shown and the Admin token input is shown again
tests.title: A 401 on create round returns the admin to the token gate with Invalid token shown
tests.scenario: Given the create-round POST returns 401, When Create round is clicked, Then the alert reads Invalid token, the Admin token input is shown again, and the Create round button is gone
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminCreateRound.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: adminLimit.test.tsx::AdminApp contribution-limit field: Create round sends no max field

tests.title: Create round request body contains no max field
